# Cryptomnia

> Cryptomnia is the memory layer for crypto. It stores every risk score, attribution, and claim as a time-stamped Event Object so you can prove what was known at the moment a decision was made.

## Key facts

- Cryptomnia keeps successive versions of risk scores, entity attributions, and claims with source and timestamp.
- As-of queries return the exact assessment that was active on a given date.
- Forgetting is auditable: marking a claim forgotten creates a permanent, queryable record. Nothing is silently overwritten.
- Every assessment carries who, when, and which source. Supporting evidence files can be attached and retrieved later.
- Built on Pod-OS (PointOfData), a time-aware multigraph database.
- Working Streamlit prototype demonstrates ingest, interactive timeline, as-of queries, forgetting, and evidence attachment.

## Links

- Website: https://cryptomnia.com

## FAQ

**What is Cryptomnia?**
Cryptomnia is the memory layer for crypto. It stores every risk score, attribution, and claim as a time-stamped Event Object with full provenance.

**How does Cryptomnia retrieve the risk score that was active on a past date?**
An as-of query returns the Event Object that was valid at the requested timestamp, including its source and provenance.

**What is auditable forgetting?**
When a source is discredited, Cryptomnia marks the assessment forgotten. The forget action itself becomes a permanent, queryable Event Object. The original record is never silently overwritten.
